message.content:
Sure! To see where your complaint stands you’ll need to look at the official tracking page:

**Option 1 – Online Portal**

| Step | What to Do |
|------|------------|
| 1️⃣ | Go to **https://www.example.com/complaints/status** |
| 2️⃣ | Log in with your registered email & password |
| 3️⃣ | Enter the reference ID you received after filing the complaint |
| 4️⃣ | Click “Check Status” |

If you’re still logged out, click *Forgot Password* to reset it quickly.

---

**Option 2 – Phone Support**

Call our dedicated complaints line:  
📞 **+1‑800‑555‑1234** (Mon–Fri 8 a.m.–5 p.m.)  

Have your reference number handy—this will let us pull up your file instantly.

---

**Tip:** If you haven’t yet received an acknowledgment email, double‑check your spam/junk folder first. That email contains the exact reference code you’ll need.

Let me know once you’ve checked, or if there’s anything else I can help with!
